title: Google product lister
description:
We are a fast-growing e-commerce company operating one US-based dropshipping clothing store, with multiple additional stores currently being built.



We are currently looking for an experienced Product Lister who can independently and efficiently add high-converting products to our Shopify stores while strictly following our internal SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) and quality standards.



This role is highly detail-oriented. We care much more about accuracy, consistency, and quality than speed alone.



Payment:

• Starting at $3 USD per fully completed and approved product listing

• The price per listing can increase quickly based on quality, consistency, speed, and reliability

• Long-term work available for reliable and high-quality team members



What will you do?



• Add products to our Shopify stores following our structured SOP workflow

• Write and optimize SEO-focused product titles and descriptions

• Upload product images and product data according to our internal guidelines

• Properly categorize, tag, and organize products for visibility and scalability

• Maintain a clean, premium, and conversion-focused product presentation

• Create clear and professional sizing charts

• Ensure all product content complies with Google Shopping Ads policies

• Make small graphic design adjustments such as changing colors, backgrounds, or simple product image edits when needed

• Carefully follow quality-control checklists before products go live



What do we expect from you?



• Proven experience with Shopify product listing (preferably for dropshipping or fashion brands)

• Ability to work fast while maintaining very high accuracy and attention to detail

• Strong understanding of SEO and keyword optimization

• Experience working with Shopify product management

• Experience using ChatGPT to improve and speed up product descriptions

• Strong understanding of Google Shopping Ads policies and restrictions

• Basic graphic design/editing skills (changing colors, editing simple product visuals, etc.)

• You must be able to strictly follow SOPs and listing instructions

• Put the word BALI in your subject line. Nothing else is required in the subject.

• You understand exactly what is allowed — and what must be strictly avoided — in product titles, descriptions, and product pages for Google Ads compliance

• Good English communication skills

• Strong attention to detail and consistency

• We are extremely strict on quality. Sloppy work, poor formatting, incorrect variants, weak descriptions, or non-compliant listings will not be accepted.



What do we offer?



• Long-term collaboration within a fast-growing international e-commerce company

• Strong opportunities to grow within the company

• Fast salary growth for team members who consistently deliver high-quality work

• Bonus structures and performance-based rewards

• The opportunity to take on more responsibility over time

• A serious and professional working environment with room for personal growth



HOW TO APPLY



Read this section carefully. Applications that do not follow these instructions will be rejected without review.



In your application message, answer these 5 questions in order. Answer each inline. No attachments or Loom videos at this stage.



Q1. How long have you worked with Shopify product listing, and for what types of ecommerce businesses (dropshipping, DTC, marketplace, fashion, etc.)?

Please name the actual companies/stores you worked for and explain your role in detail.



Q2. Describe your full workflow when adding a product to Shopify from start to finish.

Include:

• Product title creation

• SEO optimization

• Product descriptions

• Variant setup

• Image optimization

• Collection/tag organization

• Size charts

• Google Shopping compliance checks



Q3. We are very strict about Google Shopping Ads compliance.

Explain what is allowed and what should be avoided in:

• Product titles

• Product descriptions

• Pricing

• Claims

• Product images

to prevent Merchant Center suspensions or misrepresentation issues.



Q4. What tools and software have you used?



Examples:

• Shopify

• ChatGPT

• Canva

• Google Sheets

• Matrixify

• DSers

• AutoDS

• Other listing/research tools



Also explain how many products per day you can comfortably and accurately upload while maintaining quality.



Q5. Confirm your availability:

• Hours per day

• Days per week

• Your local timezone and working hours

• Are you currently employed?

• If yes, what would your start date look like?



IMPORTANT:

After your application, selected candidates will receive a short test assignment.



You will receive 2 AliExpress product links and will need to create 2 complete Shopify-ready product listings following our SOPs and formatting standards:

• Optimized product titles

• Product descriptions

• Product tags/categories

• Sizing information

• Properly formatted Shopify-ready product presentation in a Word document



Quality, structure, consistency, and attention to detail are extremely important to us.

You're not a customer service rep. You're not a traditional virtual assistant. You're the human in the loop for a business that's increasingly run with AI tools.

s before they go out. Edit for tone, accuracy, and judgment. Handle the 20% of tickets that need a real person making a real call.

Tripled revenue.

title: VA cross listing products and Product Sourcing - Long-term
description:
Hello,

I am currently looking for a reliable Virtual Assistant to help manage and grow my e-commerce operations. My goal is to find someone I can build a long-term working partnership with, rather than someone for a short one-time task.

I sell products across multiple online marketplaces, and I am looking for someone who can assist with creating, posting, and managing listings across different platforms while maintaining high standards of quality, accuracy, and organization.

Listing Creation & Management

I would like to know if you are able to assist with the following:

1. Listing Creation

o If I provide a spreadsheet containing product information, can you create individual listings for each item?

o This includes writing detailed, well-structured product descriptions.

o If necessary, can you convert Excel spreadsheets into CSV files suitable for marketplace uploads?

o Are you able to create a cohesive store aesthetic and identity? where all listings look organized, pleasing, including all relevant store information. Someone should be able to look at all items posted  and be able to identify that this a listing unique to this store and aesthetic presentation

2. Photo Editing

o Do you edit product photos so they meet marketplace requirements?

o Tasks may include resizing, background adjustments, enhancing quality, and removing watermarks when appropriate.

3. SEO Optimization

o Are you able to ensure listings are SEO-optimized, properly formatted, error-free, and visually appealing to potential buyers?

4. Cross-Listing

o Can you cross-list products across multiple marketplaces while ensuring each listing meets the specific requirements of that platform?

5. Ongoing Listing Management

o Are you able to continuously monitor and manage listings, including updates, revisions, and inventory synchronization across platforms?

Communication & Work Style

Because this will be an ongoing partnership, communication is very important.

Please let me know if you:

• Are comfortable communicating in English (written and verbal).

• Are open to occasional voice calls for efficiency when discussing tasks or projects.

• Are able to follow detailed written and verbal instructions.

• Are organized and able to maintain consistent quality control across listings.

Additional Services (Preferred for long term hire)

If you offer any of the following services, please let me know:

1. Customer Service Support

o Responding to customer inquiries

o Assisting with returns or order issues

2. Product Sourcing / Online Arbitrage

o Assisting with sourcing profitable products for platforms such as Amazon FBA or Walmart Marketplace

o Experience with tools used for product research

3. Marketing & Inventory Liquidation Strategies

o Helping develop strategies to sell through inventory efficiently

o Optimizing listings or pricing to improve sales velocity

4. Website & E-Commerce Support

o Assistance with website creation or management

o Social media integration

o SEO and website optimization

o Payment gateways, shipping systems, live chat, or coupon code systems

Final Note

Ultimately, I am looking for someone dependable, detail-oriented, and proactive who is interested in forming a long-term professional partnership and helping grow my e-commerce business over time.

If this sounds like something you would be interested in, I would love to learn more about:

• Your experience with marketplace listings

• Which platforms you have worked with

• Examples of listings or stores you have managed

Thank you, and I look forward to hearing from you.

title: Social Media VA - U.S. Content Creator
description:
???? Social Media VA — TikTok & Instagram Daily Posting + Engagement (Part-Time, Night Shift PH)



Hey! I'm a U.S.-based content creator looking for a reliable, detail-oriented VA to help me post and manage engagement on TikTok and Instagram every single day — including weekends.



This role is approximately 1 hour and 10 minutes of active work per session, plus a separate 5–15 minute comment check-in 4–5 hours after posting. The tasks are straightforward and clearly laid out — no guesswork, just follow the steps.



?????????????????????????????

WHAT YOU'LL DO EACH DAY

?????????????????????????????

• Enable VPN before doing anything else

• Scroll and engage with niche content on TikTok for 25 minutes

• Post one pre-drafted video from TikTok Studio, note the caption, then swipe out of both Tiktok and Tiktok Studio

• Draft the Instagram post immediately while the caption is fresh (the setting to automatically download content from the Tiktok app should be on in order to draft the video in Instagram!)

• Moderate comments on past Instagram posts

• Scroll and engage with niche content on Instagram for 25 minutes

• Publish the drafted Instagram Reel

• Send me a check-in message on WhatsApp once both posts are live

• Return 4–5 hours after posting for a 5–20 min comment moderation pass on both platforms (this varies depending on how many comments need tended to!)

• The following day, before starting, review overnight comments and moderate those first



You'll receive a detailed SOP covering every step, what to say in comments, what to delete, and a keyword list to guide your scroll sessions.



?????????????????????????????

SCHEDULE

?????????????????????????????

Posts must go live between 12:00 PM – 2:00 PM Eastern Time (1:00 AM – 3:00 AM Philippine Time).

You choose your exact start time within that window — whatever works best for your schedule — but pick one consistent time and stick to it every day.

The comment check-in falls 4–5 hours after your chosen posting time.

This is a night shift role. Please only apply if you are genuinely comfortable working overnight.



?????????????????????????????

COMMUNICATION

?????????????????????????????

All communication will be via WhatsApp. You will send your daily check-in message there once both posts are live, and flag any issues (missing drafts, questions about comments, etc.) through the same channel. Response times on my end may vary due to the time difference, but I will always follow up and I would expect the same from you!



?????????????????????????????

REQUIREMENTS

?????????????????????????????

? Reliable internet connection

? Smartphone or device capable of running TikTok, TikTok Studio, and Instagram

? ProtonVPN installed and connected to a U.S. server before each session (free — instructions provided if needed)

? Strong attention to detail — you'll be making judgment calls on comments

? Available 7 days a week including holidays

? Good written English for replying to comments naturally

? Must be comfortable with lifestyle/relationship content (skits, POV-style videos, rage bait)



?????????????????????????????

NICE TO HAVE

?????????????????????????????

• Experience managing a creator's social accounts

• Familiarity with TikTok Studio

• Basic understanding of social media engagement and algorithm behavior



?????????????????????????????

PAY

?????????????????????????????

$4 per session — paid bi-weekly via Wise.

title: Part time PPC Manager (Google & Bing Ads)
description:
Role Overview:

We are seeking an experienced PPC Manager to lead the development, execution, and optimization of paid search campaigns across both Google Ads and Bing Ads. The ideal candidate will have a hands-on understanding of both platforms and proven success managing large-scale, complex campaigns with significant budgets. You will be responsible for delivering results-driven campaigns that align with client goals while maintaining a deep understanding of industry best practices. Previous experience working at Google or a strong insider knowledge of Google Ads best practices is highly advantageous.

As a PPC Manager, you’ll be the go-to expert for all things paid search and will have a direct impact on client performance. The role requires a strategic mindset, data-driven decision-making, and the ability to maintain clear and effective communication with both internal teams and clients.



Key Responsibilities:

1. Paid Search Strategy & Execution:

Campaign Development & Management: Develop, launch, and manage paid search campaigns on Google Ads and Bing Ads, ensuring they are aligned with client objectives and maximize ROI. This includes campaigns on Google Search, Display, YouTube, Shopping, and Bing Search.

Keyword Research & Audience Targeting: Conduct extensive keyword research, competitor analysis, and audience segmentation to identify growth opportunities. Develop comprehensive strategies based on these insights to optimize targeting and bidding.

Campaign Optimization: Continuously analyze and refine campaigns to improve performance metrics such as CPC, CTR, CPA, and ROAS. Implement A/B testing strategies for ad creatives, landing pages, and bidding strategies to maximize conversions.

Ad Copy & Creative Strategy: Work closely with the creative team to ensure that ad copy, creatives, and landing pages are optimized for user engagement and aligned with campaign goals.

2. Client Communication & Consultation:

Client Liaison: Serve as the main point of contact for clients, providing expert consultation on all Google Ads and Bing Ads strategies. Clearly communicate campaign progress, adjustments, and results to ensure client satisfaction and alignment with business objectives.

Performance Reporting: Regularly prepare and present in-depth performance reports, including key performance metrics (CPC, CTR, CPA, ROAS) and actionable insights. Use these reports to showcase campaign successes and provide strategic recommendations for optimization.

Strategic Guidance: Offer strategic recommendations to clients, advising on how to improve campaign performance, expand reach, or address performance challenges. Proactively identify opportunities for growth.

Client Relationship Management: Build and nurture strong relationships with clients, becoming a trusted advisor on paid search and digital marketing. Ensure high levels of client satisfaction, resolve campaign-related issues, and manage client expectations effectively.

3. Budget Management & Performance Tracking:

Budget Oversight: Manage and optimize client budgets across both Google Ads and Bing Ads to ensure campaigns are efficient and within budget. Track and report on budget pacing and ensure that client goals are met while maximizing ROI.

Performance Tracking & Analysis: Utilize Google Analytics, Microsoft Advertising Intelligence, Google Tag Manager, and other analytics platforms to monitor campaign performance in real time. Assess KPIs such as CPC, CTR, CPA, and ROAS to ensure campaigns are delivering results within the defined parameters.

Optimization: Make data-driven decisions to optimize campaigns for better performance. Adjust bids, keywords, targeting, and ads based on performance trends and competitive insights.

4. Collaboration & Cross-Functional Alignment:

Team Collaboration: Work closely with the broader digital marketing team (SEO, Social Media, Creative, Web Development) to ensure that PPC campaigns are integrated into wider marketing and sales strategies. Align campaigns with broader business objectives, ensuring a cohesive approach across all digital channels.

Stakeholder Coordination: Collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure paid search efforts align with company goals and support sales or product launch strategies.

Knowledge Sharing: Actively contribute to knowledge-sharing within the marketing team by educating peers about PPC best practices, emerging trends, and new tools or features in Google Ads and Bing Ads.

5. Industry Trend Awareness & Innovation:

Stay Current with PPC Trends: Stay up-to-date with the latest Google Ads and Bing Ads updates, features, and best practices. Attend webinars, conferences, and industry events to keep ahead of emerging trends and leverage new opportunities for clients.

Test New Strategies: Continuously evaluate and experiment with new tools, bidding strategies, and ad formats to ensure campaigns are always optimized and competitive. Propose new strategies to clients based on these findings.

6. Reporting & Data-Driven Insights:

Regular Reporting: Create and maintain regular performance reports, dashboards, and presentations to track campaign progress, analyze performance trends, and showcase ROI. Present these findings in a clear, concise manner to clients and internal teams.

Actionable Insights: Translate complex data into actionable insights that drive campaign improvements. Provide clear, data-backed recommendations to both internal and client stakeholders to guide future PPC strategies and decisions.

Attribution & Conversion Tracking: Implement and manage proper tracking systems to measure campaign effectiveness and provide accurate reporting on conversions, revenue, and other key metrics.



Qualifications:

Education:

Bachelor’s Degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). Certifications in Google Ads and Bing Ads are a plus.



Experience:

Proven PPC Experience: Minimum of 3–5 years of hands-on experience managing PPC campaigns across Google Ads and Bing Ads. This includes experience in Google Search, Display, YouTube, Shopping, and Bing Search campaigns.

Agency or Client Experience: Experience working in a client-facing role, ideally in a digital marketing agency, managing multiple PPC accounts with large-scale budgets.

Experience at Google (Bonus): Previous experience working at Google or within a Google Partner agency is highly desirable, particularly if you have in-depth knowledge of Google Ads best practices, new features, and insights from working directly with the platform.



Technical Skills:

Google Ads & Bing Ads Expertise: Advanced proficiency in managing campaigns across Google Ads and Bing Ads, including search, display, shopping, remarketing, and video campaigns.

Analytics Tools Proficiency: Strong working knowledge of Google Analytics, Microsoft Advertising Intelligence, Google Tag Manager, and other relevant analytics and tracking tools to measure, report, and optimize PPC campaign performance.

Data Interpretation: Ability to analyze large datasets, interpret complex data, and turn insights into actionable strategies to optimize campaign performance.



Soft Skills:

Excellent Communication & Presentation Skills: Ability to explain complex PPC strategies and performance data in a clear, concise, and accessible manner for clients, internal teams, and stakeholders.

Client Management Experience: Proven experience in building and nurturing strong client relationships. Ability to manage client expectations and resolve issues in a timely and professional manner.

Problem-Solving & Proactive Mindset: Strong problem-solving skills, with a proactive approach to identifying and addressing campaign issues. Ability to think critically and take strategic action based on data.

Attention to Detail: High attention to detail, ensuring that campaign elements are precise and accurately reflect client objectives, even when working with large volumes of data.



How to Apply:

If you’re an experienced PPC Manager looking for a new challenge, we want to hear from you! Please submit your resume, along with a cover letter outlining your relevant experience. Include any specific campaigns or achievements that highlight your expertise with Google Ads and Bing Ads.

title: CTO / Automation Engineer — US Credit Repair & Funding Company Scaling 5x (Remote, Full-Time)
description:
ABOUT US



Better Credit Challenge (BCC) is a US-based credit repair AND funding company.



We help people fix their credit AND get funded once their credit is strong enough.

Credit repair is the front door. Funding is the bigger door behind it.

Our clients come in with damaged credit. We help them clean it up. Then we help them

access business loans, personal funding, and capital for the goals they couldn't reach

before — homes, businesses, real estate investments.



We're currently at $10K/month recurring revenue with an 8-person team (operations side

is Philippines-based, like you'd be). We're hiring the person who will help us scale

to $50K/month, then $100K, then $500K.



Our stack: GoHighLevel, Stripe, Make.com, Zapier, Meta Business Manager, ManyChat, Smart Credit, Skool, Slack, Notion.





WHAT WE NEED



We are NOT hiring a builder.

We are hiring a PROACTIVE OPERATOR.



We need someone who:

? Sees what's broken before being asked

? Spots what's missing and brings solutions

? Doesn't wait for tasks — creates the roadmap

? Stays current with automation tools and brings new ideas every month

? When BCC misses an opportunity, you're the one who noticed first

? Understands you'll be building automation for TWO sides of the business —

   credit repair workflows AND funding workflows



If you wait for instructions and only do what's asked, this role is not for you.

Please don't apply — we will not consider you and it wastes both our time.



REQUIRED SKILLS



You must have ALL of the following:



? Deep GoHighLevel (GHL) experience — workflows, custom fields, pipelines, webhooks,

  calendars, phone routing

? UTM tracking and attribution — end-to-end (you can debug why a lead source isn't

  showing up)

?
 Pixel + CAPI — full integration knowledge

? Funnel design — cold lead all the way to retained client

? Zapier OR Make.com (preferably both)

? Stripe webhook handling

? Strong English (written + spoken) — you'll work directly with our US-based founder

? Documentation discipline — you write down what you build, every time



NICE-TO-HAVE (bonus skills, not required)

? ManyChat (Instagram/Facebook messenger automation)

? Google Tag Manager + GA4

? Twilio (phone routing under the hood)

?
 deliverability (SPF/DKIM/DMARC)

? Basic JavaScript for custom webhook handling

? TikTok Pixel + CAPI

? Smart Credit or credit-related platform experience

? Experience with funding / lending / financial services automation

? Familiarity with credit score data, dispute tracking, or financial KPIs





WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY



CREDIT REPAIR SIDE:

• Build and maintain GHL workflows for lead routing, client onboarding,

  payment recovery, and retention

• Architect Smart Credit integration deeper

• Build automation around dispute round tracking and client communications

• Manage CSM workflow automation (matching, onboarding, retention)



FUNDING SIDE:

• Build automation for funding eligibility detection

  (Month 4+ clients with score progress = funding candidates)

• Architect Funding Manager workflows (consultation booking, application tracking)

• Build integrations with lender platforms as we scale

• Create funding-specific lead capture and nurture funnels



ACROSS BOTH:

• Architect attribution across Meta Ads ? GHL ? Stripe ? revenue

• Connect Stripe, GHL, Slack, Drive, Smart Credit

• Document everything you build in Notion

• Daily Slack updates to leadership

• Weekly sync with Founder and Operations Manager





BIGGER PICTURE (where you grow)



• Audit our current systems and propose improvements (proactively, not when asked)

• Spot opportunities we're missing and bring them to us

• Build infrastructure that scales from $10K to $500K MRR without rewrites

• Architect the funding side as a major revenue stream

• Eventually lead a small automation team as we grow





COMPENSATION + GROWTH



STARTING SALARY: $800 USD/month



Why we start here:

We start every hire at $800/month because we test work ethic and proactivity first,

then reward fast for proven performance. We've built in automatic raises at Month 3

and Month 6 so strong performers see growth quickly.



Be honest with yourself: if $800 feels too low for your skill level, this isn't the role.

If you want to prove yourself and earn UP fast, this is the role.



GROWTH PATH:

? Month 3 (automatic raise): $1,000/month — given you're meeting basic expectations

? Month 6 (automatic raise): $1,200/month — given you're meeting basic expectations



Beyond Month 6, raises are performance-tied:



? Month 9-12: $1,400-1,600/month for strong performers

? Year 1-2: $1,700-2,000/month for proactive operators

? Year 2-3: $2,000-2,500/month for exceptional long-term performers



PERFORMANCE BONUSES at company milestones:

• $300 bonus when BCC hits $25K MRR

• $500 bonus at $50K MRR

• $1,000 bonus at $100K MRR

• $2,500 bonus at $500K MRR



Payment: Monthly via Wise (1st of each month)

Hours: 40-45 hours/week with 4-5 hours daily overlap with US business hours

Type: Independent contractor (full-time)



???????????????????????????????????????????????????

OUR HIRING PROCESS

???????????????????????????????????????????????????



We use a multi-round filter because the wrong hire costs us months.

Here's exactly what to expect (we're upfront so you can decide if it's worth your time):



???????????????????????????????????????????????????

ROUND 1: Application + cover letter

???????????????????????????????????????????????????

(This is what you're doing now)

???????????????????????????????????????????????????

ROUND 2: 30-minute video interview

???????????????????????????????????????????????????

With our Founder and Operations Manager



???????????????????????????????????????????????????

ROUND 3: 1-week UNPAID audit task

???????????????????????????????????????????????????

(Only top 7 candidates advance to this round)



You'll get view-only access to our actual GoHighLevel account.

You audit it and deliver a 1-2 page report on:

  - What's broken

  - What's missing

  - What we should fix first

  - Estimated business impact of each fix



This round filters out candidates who aren't serious about the role.

We're transparent: this round is UNPAID. The next round IS PAID.



???????????????????????????????????????????????????

ROUND 4: 1.5-WEEK PAID BUILD ROUND ($400 USD)

???????????????????????????????????????????????????

(Only top 2 finalists from the audit advance to this round)



This is where we see if you can EXECUTE what you proposed.



WHAT YOU'LL DO:



You'll be given:

• A sandbox GoHighLevel account (separate from our live BCC account)

• 1.5 weeks (10-11 working days)

• $400 USD paid via Wise within 48 hours of presentation

• Sample data + custom fields pre-populated so you can test as you build



YOUR JOB:



Take the TOP 2 PRIORITIES from your own audit and actually build them.

Not all your recommendations. Just the 2 most critical workflows.



We want QUALITY over QUANTITY:

? 2 workflows built EXCEPTIONALLY beats 5 workflows built sloppily

? YOU choose which 2 — based on your audit's priority ranking

? The choice itself tells us how you prioritize



For each workflow, you must deliver:

1. A fully functional workflow in the sandbox (working, tested, edge cases handled)

2. Written documentation (1 page max per workflow, plain English so anyone can follow)

3. A Loom video walkthrough (5-10 minutes) showing the workflow working

4. A live 30-minute Zoom presentation with Jamal + Mary Ann at the end



???????????????????????????????????????????????????

WHAT WE'RE EVALUATING (How We Pick Between The 2)

???????????????????????????????????????????????????



Both finalists will be technically competent — you made it through the audit.

The difference between you and the other finalist will show up in HOW you build,

not WHAT you build.



We're scoring 5 traits:



1. PROACTIVITY (most important)

   ? Did you go BEYOND what was asked?

   ? Did you add monitoring, alerts, or edge case handling we didn't request?

   ? Did you document something proactively because it would help BCC?

   ? Top performers do MORE than what's specified.

2. EXECUTION QUALITY

   ? Is the workflow clean and maintainable, or hacky?

   ? Did you handle edge cases (errors, duplicates, timing issues)?

   ? Could another engineer maintain this without asking you?

3. COMMUNICATION

   ? Can you explain technical decisions to non-technical leadership clearly?

   ? Do you defend your choices with logic (not ego)?

   ? When we push back on your approach, do you discuss or get defensive?



4. EDGE CASE THINKING

   ? We will ask: 'What happens if Stripe fires twice in 1 second?'

   ? We will ask: 'What happens if the workflow errors mid-execution?'

   ? We want to see you've thought about failure modes — not just happy path.

5. DOCUMENTATION

   ? Could a stranger pick up your docs and operate the workflow?

   ? Is it organized, scannable, useful?

   ? Or a wall of text written last-minute?



???????????????????????????????????????????????????

TIMELINE FOR THE 1.5 WEEKS

???????????????????????????????????????????????????



Day 1-2:   Plan what you're building, set up sandbox, design approach

Day 3-4:   Start building Workflow #1

Day 4:     Mary Ann sends a check-in message — your response is part of evaluation

Day 5-7:   Build Workflow #2, test both thoroughly

Day 8-9:   Polish, document, record Loom walkthrough

Day 10:    Live presentation with Jamal + Mary Ann (30 min Zoom)

Day 10-11: Payment processed via Wise



About the Day 4 check-in:

Mary Ann will message you on Day 4 asking how it's going.

Proactive operators will already have a status update ready.

Reactive builders will scramble or give vague answers.

How you respond is data for us.



???????????????????????????????????????????????????

PAYMENT TERMS

???????????????????????????????????????????????????



• $400 USD paid via Wise within 48 hours of your presentation

• Paid REGARDLESS of whether you're hired

• If you complete the deliverables, you get paid — period

• Work product (the workflows you build) belongs to BCC

• By accepting the build brief, you agree to these terms



???????????????????????????????????????????????????

ROUND 5: HIRING DECISION + IMMEDIATE START

???????????????????????????????????????????????????



After both finalist presentations, Jamal + Mary Ann compare side-by-side.

We make a decision within 48 hours and move fast on the offer.

Winner starts immediately at $800/month with the growth path described above.



Total timeline: 5-6 weeks from application to hire.

We move fast, but we won't compromise on fit.





???????????????????????????????????????????????????

HOW TO APPLY (READ CAREFULLY)

???????????????????????????????????????????????????



Send your complete application to: 



Your application must include ALL of the following:



1. COVER NOTE explaining specifically why YOU are the right fit

   (Not generic. Tell us specifically about BCC and this role — show us you read

   this post.)

2. PORTFOLIO or examples of past automation work

   (Screenshots, Loom videos, GitHub, anything showing real builds you've done.

   If you can't show real work, you're not the right hire for this level of role.)

3. FIRST LINE of your cover note must be the phrase:

   I see what's broken

   (Yes, exactly that phrase. This confirms you read this entire post carefully.

   Applications that don't include this phrase will not be reviewed.)

4. YOUR CURRENT MONTHLY RATE and what you're looking for

   (Be honest — we already told you we start at $800 with auto-raises to $1,200 by

   Month 6. If that doesn't work for you, don't apply. We'd rather know now than

   waste rounds.)

5. SOONEST YOU CAN START full-time





APPLICATIONS CLOSE: 

We respond to every application within 5 business days after applications close.





FINAL NOTE

We respect your time. We move fast. We pay fairly based on demonstrated performance.

We expect excellence.



If you want to help us build the company that fixes people's credit AND funds their next chapter — and you're ready to prove yourself to earn your way up — apply.



If you're not sure you're the right fit — don't apply. We'd rather hire one great

person rather than waste time with many average ones.



Looking forward to hearing from the right person.





Jamal

Better Credit Challenge

description:
Part-time · Remote Role

Salesforce Marketing Cloud Specialist



We're a growing hair restoration clinic group with a current database of 11,000 cold leads and a Salesforce ecosystem (Sales Cloud + Marketing Cloud + PMS) that we're actively building out. We need someone who can own the
 marketing function end-to-end — not just execute campaigns, but manage the platform, maintain the data, and connect marketing activity directly to consultation bookings and overall take responsibility of the Sales & Marketing Cloud.



This is a part-time role for someone based remotely. You'll work closely with our marketing and sales team and have direct visibility into the commercial performance of everything you build and manage.



What you'll own

- Build and manage multi-step nurture journeys in Journey Builder for new leads, cold leads, and post-consultation follow-ups

- Maintain Data Extensions and Automation Studio to keep segments accurate and synced with Sales Cloud

- Manage list hygiene, deliverability monitoring, and sender reputation — bounce rates, spam complaints, suppression lists

- Report on
 performance and tie results to consultation bookings using Sales Cloud data — not just open rates

- Run A/B tests on subject lines, send times, and journey branching logic, then act on what you find

- Coordinate with the sales and clinical team so
 content reflects what's actually happening in consultations



What we need from you

- Salesforce Marketing Cloud

Hands-on experience with
 Studio, Journey Builder, and Automation Studio. Not exposure — ownership.

Data Extensions

Comfortable building and managing a structured data model in SFMC, not just using All Subscribers.



- Marketing Cloud Connect

Understands how SFMC and Sales Cloud integrate, what syncs between them, and how to troubleshoot when it breaks.



- Deliverability

SPF, DKIM, DMARC, IP warm-up, and list hygiene are conversational, not things they need to look up.



- Segmentation logic

Can look at a lead list and independently propose a segmentation model based on recency, behaviour, and stage.



- Reporting and attribution

Builds dashboards that connect
 activity to business outcomes, not just campaign-level vanity metrics.



- Certifications

The following are preferred, not mandatory — but a strong signal of platform commitment:



Salesforce Certified Marketing Cloud
 Specialist

Salesforce Certified Marketing Cloud Administrator



Experience level

3–5 years of hands-on SFMC experience. We need someone who has owned an instance, not just contributed to one. If your only
 marketing experience is in Klaviyo, Hubspot, or Mailchimp, this role isn't the right fit.



Nice to have

Experience in healthcare, aesthetics, or any high-consideration consumer service where people research for months before committing. Familiarity with SFMC Intelligence Reports or Datorama. Understanding of Australian consumer behaviour is a bonus but not required.



What you can expect from us

A platform that's being actively invested in, not a legacy system on life support. Direct access to decision-makers. A lead base that's real, sizable, and commercially meaningful. Rate to be discussed based on experience.



How to apply

Send us a short overview of a Salesforce Marketing Cloud instance you've owned — what the setup looked like, what journeys you built, and how you measured performance. Applications without this will not be progressed.

title: Meta Ad Designer for Bali Travel Brand
description:
We run
 and Instagram ads for a Bali tourism brand that offers free experiences to Australian and New Zealand couples. We're scaling for Bali's high season and need a part-time graphic designer to ship 2-3 static ads per working day, every working day.



This is high-volume execution work — not from-scratch creative design. The images and copy are supplied by us. Your job is fast, consistent, on-brand execution at a daily cadence.



Your day-to-day work:



We give you:



High-quality images from our experience partners (already edited, professional quality)

The headline copy and offer we want on each ad

A reusable template once we've nailed the first batch together



You give us:



2-3 finished static ads per working day (Monday-Friday)

Each ad delivered in both 1080x1080 (square) and 1080x1920 (vertical) formats

Clean text overlays following our brand style

Files delivered daily via Google Drive folder



We'll do a short briefing call once a week (15-30 minutes) to align on the week's direction, then daily communication via Slack or WhatsApp for ad-specific feedback.



Hard requirements (we will not consider applicants without these):



Excellent written English. All our briefs, feedback, and communication happen in English. You must be comfortable writing and refining short marketing copy, not just translating instructions.



Real Meta ad experience. Your portfolio must include actual
 and Instagram ads you've designed that ran in real campaigns — not generic graphic design work, not logo design, not mockups. We need to see ads built for performance, not portfolios built to impress.



Copywriting fundamentals. You need to understand the basics: what makes a hook work, why headline hierarchy matters, what makes a CTA convert, the difference between selling features and selling benefits. We provide the copy, but you'll often suggest refinements — you need to know enough to do that well.



Daily availability Monday-Friday. This is a daily cadence role. If you can only work in batches once or twice a week, this isn't the right fit.



Strong Canva and/or Photoshop skills



Reliable internet and a computer that runs design software smoothly



Nice to have:



Experience working with travel, tourism, or hospitality brands

Familiarity with the Australian or New Zealand market

Understanding of Meta Ads Manager and ad spec requirements



To apply:

Please send:



1. Your portfolio — link us to 3-5 actual
 or Instagram ads you've designed that have run live in real campaigns (not mockups, not student work)



2. A short paragraph about your design process, written in your own English (no AI tools — we'll be able to tell)



3. Answer this: if I gave you a beautiful photo of a couple watching sunset on a Bali beach and asked you to overlay the text "FREE Romantic Dinner for Aussie Couples in Bali — Tap to Claim," walk me through your layout decisions. Where does the headline go? Why? What's the hierarchy between the offer, the audience, and the CTA?



Question 3 is the most important one. We're looking for designers who think about conversion and copywriting hierarchy, not just visual aesthetics. Thoughtful answers get shortlisted.



Long-term role for the right person. We're scaling our ad output significantly over the next 3 months, so there's room to grow into more hours and more responsibility.

title: Volleyball Video Editor + Graphic Designer (Short-form + Long-form | Part-time)
description:
Job Overview



Totality is a growing volleyball brand based in Southern California. We run tournaments, build a college club, sell custom jerseys + merch, and post short-form content that’s already proven it can go viral.

What You’ll Be Editing



Short-form (IG Reels / TikTok / Shorts)



* Highlights, hype edits, funny 
nts, mic’d up 
nts (when available)

* Fast pacing, strong hooks, clean captions/overlays

* Trend-aware edits (without being cringe)



Long-form (YouTube)



* 8–20 minute videos (sometimes more)

* Behind-the-scenes of tournaments and business

* Volleyball games / recaps / stories



Graphics (Tournament posts + Winner posts)



* Tournament announcement flyers

* Winner graphics

* Brackets / recap posts (clean and simple)







Required Skills



* Deep understanding of volleyball (culture + terms + what 
nts matter)

    * Knowing stuff like Haikyuu is a plus (it’s a big reference point in volleyball media)

* Proven short-form editing experience (Reels/TikTok/Shorts)

* Proven long-form YouTube editing experience

* Strong with:

    * captions/overlays

    * transitions (when appropriate)

    * sound design / music timing

    * comedic timing / pacing (humor is a plus)

* Basic graphic design ability (posts/flyers/winner graphics)

* Good English (you must understand instructions clearly and communicate well)

* Able to handle 1–1.5 hours of footage, sometimes 4K, and export properly







Tools / Setup Requirements



* Computer capable of smooth editing (short + long-form)

* Stable internet

* Access To Video and Graphic Editing software you’re comfortable with (Premiere, Final Cut, DaVinci, CapCut Desktop, etc.)

* Ability to deliver files cleanly and on time







Pay + Hours



* $3/hr starting

* Part-time (hours will depend on how much content we’re producing)

* Pay will scale up over time as the brand grows and as your skill/output proves itself







How to Apply (READ CAREFULLY)



I will keep this listing open for 24 hours. If you don’t follow instructions, you won’t be considered.



1) Send a 1–2 minute introduction video (camera ON + live microphone)



In your video, quickly cover:



* Your name + where you’re from

* Your experience with volleyball (player/fan/editor)

* Your experience editing short-form + long-form

* Your experience with graphic design

* Why you think you can help Totality grow



2) Send your portfolio (links/files) *Does not need to be volleyball



* 2–3 best short-form edits (Reels/TikTok/Shorts)

* 1–2 best long-form videos (YouTube-style)

* 3–5 graphic design examples (posts/flyers/winner graphics)



3) Answer these questions in text



1. What editing software do you use?

2. Can your PC handle editing 4K footage smoothly? (Yes/No + specs)

3. What volleyball channels/pages do you watch or study?

4. What do you think makes a Reel go viral?



Subject line to use: “TOTALITY EDITOR – [Your Name]”

(If you don’t include this, I’ll assume you didn’t read the post.)







Bonus (Not Required, But Will Get You Noticed)



* If you can make volleyball edits that feel fast, funny, and hype

* If you understand “sports storytelling” (hooks, build-up, payoff)

* If you can match the vibe of modern sports creators

title: Appointment Setter + Sales Closer Pair for Australian AI Voice Bot Pilot
description:
Business Innovations Australia is running a focused one-month paid trial selling AI phone assistants for real estate agencies in Gippsland, Victoria, Australia.



Our current working example/demo is called Ava. The client does not have to sell a product named Ava to every agency. Ava is the example they can hear and test, then Business Innovations Australia builds a suitable voice bot for the agency.



Gippsland is in regional Victoria, in the bottom-right/south-east part of Australia. The first target area is real estate agencies around Sale and the wider Gippsland region.



Website/demo page: 



We are looking for a Philippines-based appointment setter and sales closer/intake specialist who already work closely together. A small team, agency, partnership, or co-owned operation is ideal.



The AI phone assistant answers missed or overflow buyer, vendor, rental, landlord, tenant, and property-management enquiry calls. It captures the caller's name, phone number, and enquiry, then sends the details to the agency team so good leads are not lost when staff are busy, at inspections, at lunch, away, or after hours.



This is not bulk spam or pressure selling. We want careful outreach, clean notes, honest qualification, and professional follow-up.





Role 1 - Appointment Setter / Cold Caller



You will:



- Call real estate agencies from a supplied Gippsland lead list.

- Ask short discovery questions about missed calls, after-hours enquiries, overflow calls, voi
, and slow follow-up.

- Explain the AI phone assistant in plain English, using Ava as the example/demo.

- Send approved
 or SMS follow-up where appropriate.

- Book qualified demo/intake calls for the closer.

- Log every call result clearly in a tracker.

- Stop immediately if someone asks not to be contacted again.





Role 2 - Sales Closer / Intake Specialist



You will:



- Join only when a qualified demo/intake call is booked.

- Confirm the agency's missed-call or overflow problem.

- Ask whether they have called the Ava example/demo, and if not, guide them to test it during or after the call.

- Explain pricing, setup, and boundaries clearly.

- Collect the information BIA needs to build the bot.

- Send the approved BIA invoice/payment link for the setup deposit.

- Handoff clean requirements after the agency pays the deposit or confirms next steps.



The closer is not paid to sit idle. Please quote either a per-qualified-demo-call rate or a per-paid-client bonus/rate.





Current Offer



We are promoting an end-of-financial-year offer:



- Normal setup: A$2,500 + GST.

- EOFY setup: A$1,500 + GST.

- Deposit: A$500 + GST to start.

- Balance: A$1,000 + GST when the bot is delivered.

- Monthly plan: about A$590 + GST including 300 answered-call minutes.



The caller should not lead with price, but must answer clearly if asked. The closer handles detailed pricing, setup, deposit, and requirements.





Important Boundaries



The AI phone assistant supports real estate staff. It does not replace them.



The AI phone assistant must not give legal advice, tenancy advice, financial advice, lending advice, contract advice, property valuations, or promises about property availability unless the agency supplies and approves that information.



You must not promise guaranteed sales, listings, rent roll growth, commissions, or revenue.



You must not take card details or hold client money. Payments go directly to Business Innovations Australia through our approved invoice/payment link.





Good Fit



Apply if you have:



- Experience calling Australian businesses.

- Real estate, property management, SaaS, local services, marketing, lead-generation, or appointment-setting experience.

- Clear spoken English and a calm phone manner.

- Reliable internet, headset, and quiet calling setup.

- Ability to work during Australia/Melbourne business hours.

- Strong call notes and follow-up discipline.

- A caller and closer who already work well together.



Bonus experience, but not mandatory:



- AI voice bots, AI automation, GoHighLevel, Vapi, Retell, Bland, Make/Zapier, CRM workflows, chatbots, or appointment-setting technology.





Trial Structure



This starts as a one-month paid trial.



Suggested starting structure:



- Caller: 3-5 hours per day during Australia/Melbourne business hours for the one-month trial, starting at the lower end while script and lead quality are tested.

- Closer: paid per qualified attended demo/intake call or per paid pilot.

- Bonus: paid only when an agency pays the setup deposit and completes onboarding.



If the trial produces good conversations, clean notes, and paid clients, there may be ongoing work.





How To Apply



Please answer these questions:



1. Are you applying as a caller only, closer only, or caller + closer pair?

2. If applying as a pair, how long have you worked together?

3. Have you called Australian businesses before? Which industries?

4. Have you worked with real estate agencies, property managers, investors, brokers, SaaS, or lead-generation offers?

5. Do you have AI automation, voice bot, GoHighLevel, Vapi, Retell, Bland, Make/Zapier, CRM, or chatbot experience?

6. Can you work during Australia/Melbourne business hours?

7. What hourly rate do you want for caller work?

8. What would the closer charge per qualified demo/intake call?

9. What bonus would motivate you when an agency pays the setup deposit?

10. How do you log calls and follow-ups?

11. What makes a booked meeting qualified?

12. What would you say if an agency says, "We already answer all our calls"?

13. Can the caller send a 30-60 second voice sample reading the sample script below?

14. Can the closer send a 30-60 second voice sample explaining Ava in plain language?

15. Do you have your own computer, headset, stable internet, and quiet workspace?

16. Do you currently have another job? If yes, how many hours per week?





Caller Voice Sample Script



Hi, is this [Agency Name]? My name is [Caller Name] from Business Innovations Australia. Quick one: do you ever miss buyer, vendor, rental, or property-management enquiry calls when the team is busy, out at inspections, at lunch, short-staffed, away, or after hours?





Closer Voice Sample Script



Our example is called Ava. Ava is a simple AI phone assistant for real estate agencies. It answers missed or overflow enquiry calls, captures the caller's name, number, and enquiry, then sends the details to your team. It supports your staff, it does not replace them, and it does not give advice. The goal is to stop good enquiries disappearing into voi
 or being missed when the office is busy. If the agency goes ahead, Business Innovations Australia builds the right voice bot for that agency.





First Trial Target



The first target is not a huge number of calls. The first target is quality:



- Clear call notes.

- Honest lead qualification.

- 1 or more serious demo/intake conversations from the first few working days.

- No spammy or pushy behaviour.

- Good daily communication.

title: Food Packaging & Print-Ready Bags (Confectionary)
description:
Packaging Designer — Food Packaging & Print-Ready Bags



We are looking for an experienced Packaging Designer with strong knowledge of food packaging, flexible bags, pouches, and print production.



This role is for someone who understands how packaging is actually printed and manufactured. We do not need a general graphic designer. We need someone who can design packaging and prepare detailed, accurate, print-ready files for printers and packaging suppliers.



You must have at least 3 years of experience in food packaging design and be confident working with dielines, bleed, safe zones, seal areas, gussets, CMYK/Pantone colors, white ink layers, barcodes, nutrition panels, ingredient lists, allergens, and final press-ready files.



You should understand printing methods such as flexographic, rotogravure, and digital packaging printing, and you should know how artwork must be prepared for bags, pouches, wrappers, and other flexible packaging formats.



The ideal candidate will have a portfolio showing real printed food packaging, especially bags or pouches. You must be able to create attractive designs while also preparing technically correct files that can be sent directly to the printer.



Requirements:



Minimum 3 years of food packaging design experience

Strong experience with flexible packaging, bags, pouches, or wrappers

Expert in Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop

Strong understanding of dielines, bleed, safe zones, gussets, folds, and seal areas

Experience preparing print-ready files for packaging suppliers

Knowledge of CMYK, Pantone, spot colors, white ink, varnish, foil, and print finishes

Experience working with nutrition facts, ingredients, allergens, barcodes, and food labeling layouts

Ability to communicate with printers and suppliers

Strong attention to detail

Portfolio with real printed packaging examples required



This position is not suitable for designers who only do branding, social media, logos, or mockups. We need someone with real packaging print-production experience.

title: Senior Wholesale Real Estate Acquisitions Specialist | $12/hr + Bonus | Long-Term Role
description:
Elk Homes, LLC is a Pennsylvania-licensed real estate wholesale investment company. We have been outsourcing through online platforms since 2011. Our employer feedback rating across 90+ hires is 4.79 stars.

We are hiring one Senior Wholesale Acquisitions Specialist for a long-term role on our team. This is a 9 AM to 5 PM Eastern Time, Monday through Friday position. The work is real, the targets are clear, and we pay above the platfor
dian because we want senior people who can do the job.



The Role 



You will work signed wholesale leads in Montgomery County and Bucks County, Pennsylvania. Each day you will dial approximately 100 motivated sellers, qualify with BANT, run comps using Bright MLS, calculate offers using the standard wholesale formula (ARV × 0.70 minus repairs minus $15,000 = MAO), present offers, negotiate, and close contracts in DocuSign. All activity is logged in real time in Follow Up Boss.



Daily Responsibilities 



Lead Management Responsibilities:



• Proactively follow up on existing leads, determine category (motivated seller, cash buyer, both, neither), and build the relationship

• Take detailed notes on every interaction; offer insight on how to progress each seller or buyer to the next step

• Track down phone numbers for hard-to-find sellers using skip-tracing tools and public records

• Analyze the nuances involved in identifying high-value sellers and qualified cash buyers

• Manage every lead through daily Follow Up Boss updates; stay on each lead until the deal closes or the lead is killed

• Tag leads appropriately per company tagging convention

• Create follow-up tasks on the team calendar in Follow Up Boss and Smarter Contact

• Engage prospects and clients to establish rapport, address objections, and close the deal

• Organize and push leads from Smarter Contact into Follow Up Boss daily, preferably in real time



Growth Deal Acquisition Tasks: 



You will need to do what AI and robots cannot — apply critical thought, run high-value analyses, and build personalized plans for each incoming lead.



• Evaluate comparable sales, property value, and property condition through research, outreach, data analysis, and market trend examination

• Coordinate site visits with the Broker or local agents (VA does not personally inspect properties)

• Coordinate rehab bid requests through Investor Boss and confirm ARV to validate deal viability

• Negotiate offers and sale prices

• Renegotiate contracts for lower prices when conditions warrant

• Prepare agreements of sale and submit to the Broker for approval



Qualities We Hire For



•  Positive & Outgoing

•  Hardworking and Trustworthy

•  Calm & Able to deal with intense deals

•  Friendly and Personable

•  Organized with great Time Management

•  Proactive. Driven towards action, not reaction.

•  Critical Mindset & Empathy

•  Persuasive. Able to convince others.

•  Bottom-line oriented

• Pragmatic, results-oriented

• Adaptive. Not rigid, able to adjust.

• Respectful of authority and direction



Compensation



• $12.00 USD per hour, weekly cap $480

• $100 bonus per signed contract that closes

• 13th-month pay in December (prorated for first year)

• Building PTO: 5 days year one, 10 days year two, 15 days year three

• Weekly pay for the first 8 weeks via Payoneer, then biweekly



???? Required Experience



• Minimum 1 year of US wholesale real estate acquisitions experience

• Native-fluent English, both spoken and written

• Experience with Follow Up Boss (or another major real estate CRM)

• Experience with a major dialer (Dialpad or RingCentral preferred)

• Comfort with paid recorded calls and daily KPI reporting



???? Required Tools (Provided by Employer)



Follow Up Boss, Dialpad (or RingCentral), DocuSign, Bright MLS access, Duo Mobile authenticator. You may not use a personal phone, WhatsApp, or any off-system communication for business purposes. All calls are made through the company-provided dialer. All leads are entered in Follow Up Boss in real time.

The phone system is locked at hire (Dialpad or RingCentral, whichever the Broker provides). The VA may not request a change to a third system after hire. Phone-system-shopping is a fraud red flag.



Required Equipment (You Provide)



• Reliable laptop with 8GB+ RAM

• Wired Ethernet internet, minimum 25 Mbps

• Professional USB headset

• Quiet, private workspace

• Backup internet and electricity

• Smartphone for 2FA



How We Train and Manage



We do not throw new hires into the deep end. Your first week is paid training and onboarding with screen-recorded walkthroughs. You will have direct access to me (the Broker of Record) by message and weekly Zoom from Day 8 forward. I review one of your calls every day in your first 60 days and send you a voice memo with feedback. This is the fastest way I know to make a new acquisitions VA into a great one.



How to Apply



Start your application with the phrase “Hi Lori, Bavaro Beach” so I know you read this post carefully. Then answer these four questions:



1. How many years of wholesale acquisitions experience do you have, and at which companies?

2. What dialer and CRM did you use most recently?

3. What was your average dial-to-contract ratio per week?

4. What is your hourly rate expectation, and are you available full-time 9-5 EST?



What Happens Next



After applications close, we run a written
 interview (no
 until later). Finalists complete a paid 3-day trial ($80 USD, 20 leads, real work). The trial winner is hired for a 5-month probationary period.

This is a long-term seat. We are not looking for someone who will be here for 90 days and then be gone. If you have the experience and you want a stable home with a calm, professional Broker, apply.

title: Media Buyer — Virtual Assistant (Remote, Hourly)
description:
Joburn Pte. Ltd.



We're an AI-powered growth agency. We've driven over $5M in client revenue in two years — our flagship client went from $15K/month to over $1M ARR under our system.



We don't do "run some ads and see what happens." We build compounding growth machines: diagnostic audits, analytics pipelines, ad creative engines, CRM automation, and conversion tracking — all wired together so every dollar spent teaches us something.



The agency is scaling from a handful of high-touch clients to 50+ Growth Partner accounts. That's where you come in.



What you're actually doing



You're the person who makes sure campaigns are built right, running clean, and improving every week.



Here's what a typical day looks like:



Morning: Check in via Slack standup. Review yesterday's ad performance across client accounts in Meta Ads Manager. Flag anything bleeding money.

Mid-day: Launch new ad sets, swap out fatigued creatives, adjust budgets based on CPA and ROAS trends. Most of this takes 30–60 minutes per client — not days.

Afternoon: Pull performance data, build client reports that actually say something useful (not just screenshots of dashboards), and feed winning patterns back into our system so the next round of creative is sharper than the last.

You'll work primarily inside Meta Ads Manager 
 + Instagram), with more platforms coming as we scale. You'll also touch GoHighLevel (our CRM — tracking leads from ad click to closed deal), 
 (automation that routes creatives, pulls data, and syncs everything), and Supabase (where all the performance data lives).



You don't need to be an expert in all of those on day one. But you need to be fluent in Ads Manager. That's non-negotiable.



The AI part — read this carefully



Our system uses AI for roughly 90–95% of the operational work. Claude writes first-draft ad copy. 
 routes it through approval flows. HeyGen and ElevenLabs produce video creative. Supabase stores and surfaces the analytics.



Your job is the final 5–10%. The part that actually determines whether the money was well spent. You're checking that campaign structures make sense, audiences are right, budgets aren't misconfigured, and nothing's quietly wasting spend at 2am.



That 5–10% is where the skill lives. AI can generate. You d
 what ships.



And here's the part most job posts won't say: at some point, AI will handle media buying end-to-end. The people who thrive here are the ones who treat AI as a tool that makes them faster — not a threat they're competing against. If you understand that and want to be on the right side of it, we want to talk.



What we need from you



Must-haves:



Hands-on experience in
 Ads Manager. You've spent real budgets, managed real campaigns, and made real optimization decisions. Not "I completed a course." You should be able to open an unfamiliar ad account, audit what's running, and tell us what's broken within 30 minutes.

You think in hours, not days. When something needs doing, you do it now. Most tasks here are 30–60 minutes, maybe two hours. "I'll get to it by end of week" doesn't work here.

Analytical instinct. You see a CPL spike and you already have three hypotheses before anyone asks.

Detail obsession. Wrong UTM parameters, mismatched audiences, typos in ad copy — that stuff should physically bother you.

Rock-solid internet. Not "usually fine." You're managing live ad spend. A dropped connection at the wrong time costs real money.

Good to have:



Experience with GoHighLevel, 
, or any CRM/automation platform

Comfort working alongside AI tools (if you already use ChatGPT or Claude for work, say so)

Experience building client-facing performance reports — not just pulling numbers, but explaining what they mean and what to do next

What you get



Hourly role. You start at a rate that reflects where you are right now. Prove you can execute, and the rate moves up. We don't cap people who deliver results.

Performance incentives tied to the outcomes you drive. We reward people who make our clients money.

Training on our systems. You'll learn our AI stack, our creative frameworks, our reporting standards. We invest in people who are in it for real — but we can't teach you how to think. The foundations need to already be there.

A seat at a small, fast team. This isn't a 200-person agency where you're a cog. You'll work directly with the people building the system. Your input shapes how we operate.

100% remote. Work from wherever. Just be reachable, be fast, and deliver.

To apply



Reply with the subject line: "The capital of Japan is [your answer]"



If you can't follow that one instruction, we already have our answer.

title: Senior US Tax Reviewer (UltraTax/CCH) — Full-Time
description:
About Whyte CPA P.C.

We're a virtual CPA firm in Gilbert, Arizona serving about 60 monthly clients. Our niche is S-corporation owners and real estate investors. Small firm, lean operation, high standards on the work that goes out the door. 



The owner currently does all final review and signs every return. That bottleneck is why this role exists. We need a senior reviewer who hits the ground running and produces output clean enough that the owner's final pass is a 10-minute confirmation, not real review work.



What You'll Actually Do

This is a year-round, full-time, review-first role. Here's what you'll spend your time on: 



Tax return review. Federal and state returns prepared by staff. Heavy on 1040s with K-1s, 1120Ss, partnerships, and 1041s. Most returns include K-1s coming in (most prepared by us), Schedule E with rentals, brokerage statements, and frequently a Schedule C or Schedule E pg 1. These are not generic 1040s. You catch errors, identify missed positions, flag judgment calls, and write clear review notes back to the preparer. 



Bookkeeping review (monthly). QBO books prepared by staff each month. You don't do bookkeeping — but you must be able to review it at a senior level. You identify reconciliation issues, miscoded transactions, and items affecting tax planning before the books feed into planning workups. 



Quarterly tax planning review. Staff prepares projections in UltraTax's tax planner using annualized financials. You review for accuracy, identify missed strategies, and flag unreasonable assumptions before the work reaches the owner and client. You may also handle some planning prep directly on the most complex clients, or step in when staff bandwidth is tight.



 IRS and state tax authority correspondence. Notice review, research, and drafting responses. Volume is low (a few per month). Routine notices (math errors, balance due, missing forms) you handle end-to-end. Complex resolution work (payment plans, penalty abatement, audits, OICs, appeals) is collaborative — you bring the research and reasoning, we work through the approach together, owner reviews and signs. We don't expect deep OIC or appeals experience on day one. We expect a strong thinker who can learn the procedures. Owner holds representation authority before the IRS; EA credential is a plus but not required. IRS Solutions Software is used for transcripts and case management.



Complex return prep. Most prep work is handled by staff. You'll prepare returns yourself when they require senior-level judgment from prep through completion, or when staff bandwidth is tight. This is not the bulk of your time, but it will happen, and we want someone who treats it as part of the role rather than an exception.



New service lines we may build together. We're exploring bringing cost segregation studies in-house and may add other advisory work over time. We're not looking for someone who has done it all before — we're looking for someone who can think critically, learn alongside us, and bring solutions rather than problems.



Who You Are

You have 5–7 years of US tax experience, with 2–3 years specifically in a review capacity — not just preparation. Be ready to talk about the difference. A preparer who started reviewing six months ago is not what we're looking for. A preparer for three years who has been reviewing for three years is.



 You have hands-on experience with UltraTax CS, CCH Axcess, Lacerte, or ProConnect.



You know S-corp work concretely: basis tracking, §199A computation, reasonable comp analysis, distributions vs. wages. Partnership review experience is a strong plus.



You write in clear, professional English (C1 or C2). Review notes need to be actionable for the preparer. Client communications need to land cleanly with US clients.



You are detail-oriented and self-policing. When you don't know something, you say so and look it up rather than guessing. You flag your own uncertainty before someone has to ask.



You are comfortable with AI-augmented workflows. Our review process uses Claude and TaxGPT alongside human judgment. The AI workflow is firm standard, not optional. Strong candidates are either already using AI tools in their work or genuinely curious to learn. Candidates who view AI as a gimmick or want to skip it on "easy" returns are not a fit.



You are self-directed in a remote-first environment. The owner travels for portions of the year and your time zone overlap will shift accordingly. We need someone who can run the review function with minimal oversight, not someone who needs daily check-ins to stay on track.



Real estate experience (rentals, short-term rentals, cost segregation, 1031 exchanges) is helpful but not required. We can teach the niche; we can't teach review judgment.



Software Stack

Required: UltraTax CS (preferred) or CCH Axcess, TaxDome, QuickBooks Online

Acceptable in place of UltraTax: Lacerte or ProConnect with willingness to learn UltraTax

Not acceptable: Drake-only experience

Used in workflow: Claude Pro, TaxGPT (Agent Andrew), IRS Solutions, Excel, Adobe Acrobat Pro



If your tax software experience is Drake only, please don't apply. We're not the right fit.



Compensation Detail

Base salary: $3,800/month USD (paid twice monthly via Wise, on time, every time)

13th month: $3,800 paid in December, prorated for partial first year

Internet stipend: $50/month

Total annual comp: $50,000 USD



Hours: Full-time. Compensation is salary — you are not paid hourly or for overtime. The expectation is that work gets done at high quality. During tax season (Feb 1–April 15), expect 50–55 hour weeks. In off-season, you manage your own time as long as work is current and communication is maintained.



Tax season support: One long weekend (Friday–Sunday) off during tax season, scheduled with two weeks notice, to maintain consistent quality.



 Philippine holidays: All standard PH public holidays observed and paid. No work expected.



 Off-season flexibility: Take time when work is slow. We don't track formal PTO. Work gets done, communication is maintained, time is yours to manage.



Negotiation: Base may be increased to $4,000/month for an exceptional candidate after the test process.



Hiring Process

1. Application — Submit per the instructions below. Generic applications are discarded immediately.

2. First screen — 30-minute video call with the owner.

3. Paid test return — One real return (sanitized client data), $400 USD, ~3–4 hours of your time, due within 7 days. You produce review notes in your own format using your own workflow. We're testing your judgment, not your ability to follow our SOP.

4. Judgment interview — 30-minute call discussing your test return, plus 2–3 scenario questions about how you'd handle specific review situations.

5. Reference check — One reference from a recent supervisor or peer reviewer who can speak to your work.

6. Offer



Total process: 2–3 weeks for serious candidates.



How to Apply

Send your application with the subject line: "Senior Reviewer — [Your Full Name]"



Include the following in the body. If your application doesn't follow this structure, we'll assume you didn't read the post and won't respond.



1. Experience summary (3–5 sentences): Your years in US tax, your years specifically in a review capacity, the type of firm you've worked at (US firm, mid-tier PH outsourcing operation, etc.), and the volume/type of returns you've reviewed.



2. Tax software: Which of UltraTax CS, CCH Axcess, Lacerte, ProConnect have you used? For each, name the specific modules (1040, 1120S, 1065, 1041) and roughly how many returns you've worked in each.



3. DISC scores (if available). If you haven't taken DISC, OnlineJobs.ph has a free 10-minute test — please take it before applying.



 4. A specific review catch you're proud of (2–3 sentences): What was the issue, how did you find it, what was the correction, what would have happened if it shipped uncaught. Specific and technical, not abstract.



 5. AI in your workflow (2–3 sentences): How do you currently use Claude, ChatGPT, or other AI tools in your tax work? If you don't currently use them, how would you approach learning a firm's AI-augmented review process?



 6. Availability: Earliest start date and any current employment that would need to transition.



We're hiring for fit, not speed. Process moves quickly for serious applicants — but we'll wait for the right person.



What This Role Is Not

— Not part-time or seasonal

— Not for someone learning US tax (you should already know it)

— Not a stepping stone to bigger firms — we want someone who wants to settle in



 We're looking forward to hearing from you.

mbers. title: Amazon Sourcer
description:
ONLINE ARBITRAGE

Looking to grow our team!Seeking one part time position who will undergo a trial period of one week paid before being brought on as part time.



We are more than an Amazon arbitrage (OA) business. If you seek a long term, advancing position, this is for you.



PSA

We have systems in place to ensure we don’t bring on any bad actors. If you plan on sending us leads that are being shared across other businesses or you are pulling items off of a leads list, you will be let go immediately.



We are seeking a part time product sourcer who can grow in our company and later be promoted to a higher paid managerial role. If you are not a hard worker and can’t prove it to us over our interview process, don’t even bother completing this application.



Job Responsibilities

Tasked with sourcing in-stock 3-6 leads a day.



Follow up, build and maintain SOPs.



Requirements

Keepa experience required

Seller Amp (SAS) experience

Online Arbitrage experience

Familiar with manual, reverse/storefront stalking, keepa product finder

Understanding ROI, margin and sales rank

Ability to work part time (20 hours per week)

Reliable internet Compensation & Benefits

Unlimited PTO

Holidays Off

Bonuses which will be discussed

Communication Skills



This should be simple, we're looking for people who don't need much supervision. Someone that is dependable and eager to work. We know this is a very competitive market and we are looking for a rockstar team member we can rely on for years and years to come. We need someone who pays attention to detail and understands how to properly read data. We expect the majority of the items to be shared with our team to be purchasable and pass all of our SOP checks.  Loyalty is the most important thing to our team. We're looking for people who want to stay with us long term and can see themselves in management /senior roles. If you've read this far, congratulations as I've found out many don't. Please put your favorite fruit as the title of your application.

Furthermore, we will not be accepting any candidates who already work for another client as we need exclusivity. Discord will be required for team communications.



If you want your application expedited please send over 3 leads researched from the same day of your application.

Include Supplier Link & Amazon US link.

This is our criteria.

Low sales rank

Minimum 30% ROI

Keepa chart shows low odds of going below break even price



In addition please answer the following questions in your application submission.

Have you been previously employed to be an online arbitrage sourcer?

If so, why did you leave your current candidate?

How many monitors do you have?

Why should we choose you as one of our candidates?

What is your favorite sport and why ?  

Do you have a Seller Amp and Keepa subscription?



Thanks for taking the time out of your day to apply, best of luck!
